info.name: ARA Workspace API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the ARA Workspace backend.

1. Select the **ARA Workspace – Local** environment.
2. Run **Auth → Login** — its test script stores `token` and `employeeId` for every other request.
3. Run **Workspaces → List workspaces** — it stores the first `workspaceId`.

All other requests use Bearer `{{token}}` from the collection auth.

request.description: Rate limited: 20 attempts per 15 minutes per IP.
At least 8 characters with a letter and a number.

item.name: Workspaces
item.description: Companies / entities. Master Admin sees all; others only the ones they belong to.

request.description: Needs workspace.create. adminIds must have at least one employee.
Send only the fields you want to change. adminIds replaces the admin list.
Returns only the groups/teams the caller can see, plus `access` for the caller and `grants` per member.
The lead automatically gets Edit access on the group.
Lead and members automatically get Edit access on the team.

request.description: workspace: 'view' | 'edit' | null. groups/teams: map of id → 'view' | 'edit'. Most specific wins (team > group > workspace). Admins of the workspace bypass grants.
